audit.whatIsWrong: The already-audited Fiora side flipped rows 0-2 to Fiora and row 5 to Skill as one atomic group. This side still reads Skill / Vayne / Vayne for rows 0-2 and Vayne for row 5, so the two pages would answer 'who wins Level 1' differently. Row 6 also contradicts its own text: it reads Vayne while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say a fed Fiora out-duels you.
audit.why: 48.97% over 872 games is a slight Vayne loss, and the shape both sides now describe is Fiora early, even through the middle, Fiora late. Mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement I left in rows 0-2 and 5 anyway.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side and win[0..2] = Fiora (4/10); phases[5].side and win[5] = Skill (5/10); phases[6].side and win[6] = Fiora (3/10). Rows 3 and 4 stay Skill at 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: "NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere" — sequencingCues is 0. Eight fields tell you to track Lunge and none give a number, and the ability that actually gates your commit is Riposte, which is never timed either.
audit.why: Lunge is 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s — long at rank 1, short by rank 5, which is exactly why the lane drifts to her. Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s and Grand Challenge 110/90/70s. Vayne's Condemn is 20s at rank 1 and Final Hour 100s.
audit.corrected: Lunge 13s at rank 1 stated in phases[2].why and spikes[0]; Riposte 24s at rank 1 stated in phases[5].why, early and dontsFull[1].d as the gate on committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions were absent. Lunge applies on-hit effects, so her damage scales with attack speed and item procs rather than raw AD — armour alone reads the trade wrong. Duelist's Dance vitals and Grand Challenge both heal her, and the page never times Grievous Wounds against them despite report[8] listing Executioner's. dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d also carried text unrelated to their own titles.
audit.why: The healing is why she wins extended trades and the on-hit is why her early Lunge hurts more than its AD suggests. Riposte parrying Condemn into a stun is already stated correctly across three fields and the Fiora side verified it, so I left that wording alone and only added its cooldown.
audit.corrected: Lunge (Q) applies on-hit; Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge heal her, so Executioner's Calling comes early; Riposte (W) parries Condemn and returns a stun on a 24s rank-1 cooldown.
